@graph.name: LDAC-DMLex Profile (DRAFT)
@graph.description: DRAFT: a Language Data Commons (LDAC) adaptation of the OASIS DMLex data model for lexicography. This is a first, machine-generated version and will be refined. It describes DMLex lexicographic resources (dictionaries) as RO-Crates, using the DMLex RDF vocabulary, with the per-class cardinality that DMLex specifies (e.g. exactly one headword per entry).

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:CollocateMarker
@graph.name: Collocate Marker
@graph.rdfs:comment: Marks up a substring other than the headword inside an example, inside an example translation or inside a definition.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Definition
@graph.name: Definition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possibly several definitions of a sense.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:DefinitionTypeTag
@graph.name: Definition Type Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for definitionType of definition.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Etymology
@graph.name: Etymology
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a chain of historical derivations of a word.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Etymon
@graph.name: Etymon
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one stage (of possibly several) in the etymological history of the headword.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:EtymonLanguage
@graph.name: Etymon Language
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of several allowed values for the language property of etymonUnit objects.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:EtymonType
@graph.name: Etymon Type
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possible values for the type of etymon.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:EtymonUnit
@graph.name: Etymon Unit
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a form (typically a word) which is the etymological origin of the headword, or another etymologically related form.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Example
@graph.name: Example
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a sentence or other text fragment which illustrates the headword being used.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:ExampleTranslation
@graph.name: Example Translation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the translation of an example.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:HeadwordExplanation
@graph.name: Headword Explanation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a statement in the translation language which explains (but does not translate) the meaning of the headword.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:HeadwordMarker
@graph.name: Headword Marker
@graph.rdfs:comment: Marks up a substring inside an example, inside an example translation or inside a definition which corresponds to the headword (or to a translation of the headword).

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:HeadwordTranslation
@graph.name: Headword Translation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possibly multiple translations of a headword.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:InflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of possibly many) inflected forms of the headword.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:InflectedFormTag
@graph.name: Inflected Form Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for tag of inflectedForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Label
@graph.name: Label
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a restriction on its parent such as temporal (old-fashioned, neologism), regional (dialect), register (formal, colloquial), domain (medicine, politics) or grammar (singular-only).

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:LabelTag
@graph.name: Label Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for tag of label.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:LabelTypeTag
@graph.name: Label Type Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for typeTag of labelTag.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Member
@graph.name: Member
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the fact that an object, such as an entry or a sense, is a member of a relation.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:MemberType
@graph.name: Member Type
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possible values for the role of member, as well as various restrictions on members having this role.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:PartOfSpeech
@graph.name: Part of Speech
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a part of speech label.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:PartOfSpeechTag
@graph.name: Part of Speech Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for tag of partOfSpeech.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:PlaceholderMarker
@graph.name: Placeholder Marker
@graph.rdfs:comment: Marks up a substring inside a headword or inside a headword translation which is not part of the expression itself but stands for things that can take its place.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Pronunciation
@graph.name: Pronunciation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the pronunciation of its parent. Pronunciations must have either a sound file or a transcription.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Relation
@graph.name: Relation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the fact that a relation exists between two or more objects.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:RelationType
@graph.name: Relation Type
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possible values for the type of relation.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Sense
@graph.name: Sense
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possibly many meanings (or meaning potentials) of the headword.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:SourceIdentityTag
@graph.name: Source Identity Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for sourceIdentity of example.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:Transcription
@graph.name: Transcription
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the transcription of a pronunciation in some notation such as IPA.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:TranscriptionSchemeTag
@graph.name: Transcription Scheme Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for scheme of transcription.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.

@graph.rdfs:label: dmlex:TranslationLanguage
@graph.name: TranslationLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of the languages in which translations are given in this lexicographic resource.
